entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: An accomplished cryomancer and planeswalker who uses ice magic, compassionate and curious.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: Will's sister, who shares a Spark with him.

events.summary: Will and his sister Rowan are the only known planeswalkers to share a Spark; wherever one goes the other must follow.
events.quote: the only Planeswalkers known to share a Spark.

relations.note: Brother and sister who share a Spark.
relations.quote: Will Kenrith and his sister Rowan are unique in the Multiverse
